considerations: This requires Ivanti appliance process, file or forensic events mapped to CEF with paths preserved in Message or Activity. Standard VPN connection events usually lack those fields.
This is a campaign-specific post-compromise hunt. Matches support investigation of the reported incident pattern and cannot identify which vulnerability was used at a given appliance.

Verify any matching path against approved diagnostics, preserve available appliance and downstream identity evidence, and check Ivanti's guidance on forensic collection. The investigators reported log tampering.
description: Find forwarded Ivanti events that mention the hidden-directory sniffer or companion credential parser recovered by Volexity after compromise.

evidence.claim: Volexity recovered a masquerading packet sniffer and its credential-parsing companion script after compromise of an Ivanti Connect Secure appliance. Its October 29 update identifies CVE-2026-111357 as the privilege-escalation stage.
evidence.location: October 29 update, LDAP Packet Capture, and Ivanti Memory Analysis with Volexity Volcano

expected_output: One row per matching forwarded event, with the artifact, available device and network fields, and source log message.

history.summary: Created evidence-backed hunt and validated all supported variants.

hypothesis: The combination of the appliance's hidden capture directory and a rare executable or script name can identify artifacts seen after an exploit chain involving CVE-2026-111357.
performance: Time filter first, then table-specific predicates and a narrow projection.
scope: Evidence review, static checks, Microsoft Kusto syntax and schema analysis. Engine and workspace execution not run.
title: Ivanti Connect Secure Post-Compromise Capture Artifacts

1.json:
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where DeviceVendor in~ ("Ivanti", "Pulse Secure") or DeviceProduct contains "Connect Secure"
| extend EventText = strcat(Activity, " ", Message)
| extend MatchedArtifact = extract(@"(/[.]icscap/(?:dsstatmond|h[.]py))(?:[^a-zA-Z0-9._/-]|$)", 1, EventText)
| where isnotempty(MatchedArtifact)
| project TimeGenerated, MatchedArtifact, Activity, DeviceVendor, DeviceProduct, DestinationHostName, SourceIP, DestinationIP, DeviceAction, Message
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| summarize Results = make_list(pack_all())
| project JSON = tostring(Results)
